acceptedExplanation.text: 就是在「實驗性功能」裡放一個勾選項：没勾显示平常操作说明；勾起來顯示物件、名稱、狀態與能顯示的資料。只讀不改圖，長資料另行展開。
acceptedExplanation.kind: Normalized from directly read PM explanation immediately before Human acceptance.

acceptedArchitectureBoundary.quote: 它只是多一個「查看現有資料」的方式：不改物件、不另外維護一份狀態，也不繞過原本的讀取規則。有些資料目前讀不到，就先明確顯示「未提供」，不用為了這個功能重做核心。

acceptedRequirements: One experimental checkbox toggles normal hover operation hints and diagnostic object information; not a standalone action button or requirement to hold keyboard Alt.
Unchecked retains original operation hints. Checked shows kind, name/identity and current state plus readable data already formally exposed.
Long details can be expanded separately without covering the workspace with a giant hover.
Use existing official read-only projections; do not mutate model, duplicate canonical state or bypass read/lifetime authority.
Unavailable information explicitly says 未提供. No core redesign, private-state traversal, general reflection or serialization framework.
engineeringConstraints: Separate committed model data, field draft and UI state; serializable preview is not a product-save contract.
Do not serialize DOM, functions, writable capabilities or live leases.
Target switch/delete/reload invalidates old information. Hover does not change selection or steal drag/wire/focus/IME and never adds Graph History.
Do not capture or serialize the entire Graph on every pointer move. Read current target on demand via existing projection.
Initial scope is existing built-in objects and public information. No universal third-party internals guarantee.
Default and persistence follow existing Preferences policy as documented engineering choices, not automatic adoption of Legacy footer.
requestedAction: Coordinator to sequence a bounded S06 implementation/review handoff after current repair04 result. Designated maintainer persists this receipt and registers accepted requirement as unimplemented until delivered. Do not mutate fixed I4/R4 or original evidence.
outputLocation: This immutable Coordinator receipt; product/state maintenance by original writer only.

Do not start second writer or modify repair03/review04 scope.
provenance: PM delivered the normalized decision; Coordinator independently read the Human acceptance and preceding concise explanations. Registration timestamp is not an invented Human message timestamp.
